name: 图片附件
desc: 添加弹窗支持选图与直接粘贴（canvas 压缩成 data:image/jpeg 缩略图）、缩略图可移除、AI 按钮在有图时变「AI 识别图片」、点「添加」后任务带图并在列表显示缩略图、详情弹窗显示大图且可移除、刷新后图片仍落盘（AI 识图调用依赖模型，不在用例里跑）

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.setItem('__todo_store_id', JSON.stringify({ id: 'conjure-todo-app-test', exp: Date.now() + 600000 })); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.item = (t) => T.items().find((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.need = (t) => { const i = T.item(t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.openAdd = async () => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(450); if (!T.dlg()) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); return true; }; T.aiBtn = () => { const d = T.dlg(); const b = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => T.tx(x).indexOf('AI') === 0); if (!b) throw new Error('弹窗里找不到 AI 按钮'); return b; }; T.mkImage = async (label) => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 240; c.height = 120; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.fillRect(0, 0, 240, 120); x.fillStyle = '#000'; x.font = '24px sans-serif'; x.fillText(label, 16, 70); return await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob(r, 'image/png')); }; T.pasteImage = async (label) => { const blob = await T.mkImage(label); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([blob], 'note.png', { type: 'image/png' })); const ev = new Event('paste', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true }); ev.clipboardData = dt; T.dlg().querySelector('.ai-field').dispatchEvent(ev); return true; }; T.pickImages = async (n) => { const dt = new DataTransfer(); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const blob = await T.mkImage('pick' + i); dt.items.add(new File([blob], 'p' + i + '.png', { type: 'image/png' })); } const input = T.dlg().querySelector('.img-input'); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.thumbs = () => T.dlg().querySelectorAll('.thumb').length; T.waitThumbs = async (n, ms) => { const steps = Math.ceil((ms || 6000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) { if (T.thumbs() === n) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('等待缩略图 ' + n + ' 张超时，实际 ' + T.thumbs()); }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.openAdd(); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d.querySelector('.img-drop')) throw new Error('添加弹窗应有选图区'); if (!d.querySelector('.img-input')) throw new Error('缺少 file input'); if (T.tx(T.aiBtn()) !== 'AI 生成') throw new Error('没图时 AI 按钮应是「AI 生成」，实际 ' + T.tx(T.aiBtn())); if (!T.aiBtn().hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('没文本没图时 AI 按钮应禁用'); await T.pasteImage('买牛奶'); await T.waitThumbs(1); const img = d.querySelector('.thumb img'); if (String(img.getAttribute('src')).indexOf('data:image/jpeg') !== 0) throw new Error('缩略图应是被压成 JPEG 的 dataURL，实际 ' + String(img.getAttribute('src')).slice(0, 30)); if (getComputedStyle(img).width !== '64px') throw new Error('缩略图应为 64px，实际 ' + getComputedStyle(img).width); if (getComputedStyle(d.querySelector('.thumb-del')).width !== '20px') throw new Error('移除按钮尺寸不对'); if (T.tx(d.querySelector('.img-note')).indexOf('1 张') === -1) throw new Error('提示应说明已添加 1 张：' + T.tx(d.querySelector('.img-note'))); if (T.tx(T.aiBtn()) !== 'AI 识别图片') throw new Error('有图时 AI 按钮应变「AI 识别图片」，实际 ' + T.tx(T.aiBtn())); if (T.aiBtn().hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('有图时应能点「AI 识别图片」（无需文本）'); return 'ok：粘贴入图并切换 AI 按钮';

await T.pickImages(2); await T.waitThumbs(3); if (T.thumbs() !== 3) throw new Error('选图后应有 3 张，实际 ' + T.thumbs()); T.click(T.dlg().querySelector('.thumb-del')); await T.waitThumbs(2); if (T.tx(T.dlg().querySelector('.img-note')).indexOf('2 张') === -1) throw new Error('移除后提示应变成 2 张：' + T.tx(T.dlg().querySelector('.img-note'))); return 'ok：3 张 -> 移除 1 张 -> 2 张';

T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.dialog-field'), '带图任务'); await T.wait(350); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(600); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('添加成功后弹窗应关闭'); const i = T.need('带图任务'); const thumbs = i.querySelectorAll('.thumb-sm'); if (thumbs.length !== 2) throw new Error('列表行应有 2 张缩略图，实际 ' + thumbs.length); if (getComputedStyle(thumbs[0]).width !== '40px') throw new Error('列表缩略图应为 40px，实际 ' + getComputedStyle(thumbs[0]).width); if (String(thumbs[0].getAttribute('src')).indexOf('data:image/jpeg') !== 0) throw new Error('列表缩略图 src 不是图片 dataURL'); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '1 项未完成 · 共 1 项') throw new Error('底部统计不正确：' + f); return 'ok：任务带 2 张图落列表';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 1) throw new Error('刷新后应有 1 条任务，实际 ' + items.length); const thumbs = items[0].querySelectorAll('.thumb-sm'); if (thumbs.length !== 2) throw new Error('刷新后图片未落盘，实际 ' + thumbs.length + ' 张'); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const todos = await s.getItem('todos'); if (!todos || todos.length !== 1) throw new Error('存储里没有任务'); if ((todos[0].images || []).length !== 2) throw new Error('存储里图片数量不对：' + JSON.stringify((todos[0].images || []).map((x) => Object.keys(x)))); if (String(todos[0].images[0].dataUrl).indexOf('data:image/') !== 0) throw new Error('存储里的图片不是 dataURL'); return 'ok：刷新后 2 张图仍在';

const root = document.querySelector('o-page').shadowRoot; const item = root.querySelector('.item'); item.querySelector('.body').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const dlg = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('st-dialog')).find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')); if (!dlg) throw new Error('点正文应打开详情弹窗'); const dimgs = dlg.querySelectorAll('.dimg'); if (dimgs.length !== 2) throw new Error('详情里应有 2 张大图，实际 ' + dimgs.length); const img = dlg.querySelector('.dimg img'); if (!img.getAttribute('src').startsWith('data:image/jpeg')) throw new Error('详情大图 src 不对'); if (Number(getComputedStyle(img).maxHeight.replace('px', '')) > 240) throw new Error('详情大图高度上限不合理：' + getComputedStyle(img).maxHeight); return 'ok：详情显示 2 张大图';

const root = document.querySelector('o-page').shadowRoot; const dlg = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('st-dialog')).find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')); dlg.querySelector('.dimg .thumb-del').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); if (dlg.querySelectorAll('.dimg').length !== 1) throw new Error('移除后详情应剩 1 张，实际 ' + dlg.querySelectorAll('.dimg').length); if (root.querySelector('.item').querySelectorAll('.thumb-sm').length !== 1) throw new Error('列表缩略图未同步'); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const todos = await s.getItem('todos'); if ((todos[0].images || []).length !== 1) throw new Error('移除未落盘：' + (todos[0].images || []).length); return 'ok：详情移除一张并落盘';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.removeItem('__todo_store_id'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
